source: By construction, confirmed by `ale validate`'s oracle pass: validate-46547719 (2026-11-18, engine bfb7505, a clean checkout of 8d983e02 made with umask 022): dual_mode_score 1.0 = (offline reward 1.0 + online reward 1.0) / 2. The offline item graded the reference program frozen at the graded start (2 files) on the three hidden scenes as main does: cleaning_score 0.930556, ratio 0.99995 to main's anchor 0.9306 (tests/anchor_offline.json); the online item scored the graded episode hidden-1: 0.916667, ratio 1.0 to tests/anchor_online.json. Untouched: 0.0. Each item is normalised by its own measured anchor, so an oracle that reaches both anchors scores 1.0.
note: dual mode (experimental): reward = (offline reward + online reward) / 2, each the item's unrounded reward (robotics_grader.ratio_rewards against its own anchor, cap 1.5 and full_at 0.98); the mean is written through ratio_rewards once more against this anchor with cap 1.0 and full_at 1.0, so the reward is the mean itself. The offline item grades the program frozen at the graded start (or at the session's end when the episode is never started) exactly as main does; the online item scores the graded episode's record as the online variant does.
